content.value: In a national transmission system, the characteristics impedances of a 4-wire circuit and the 2-wire circuit are 1000 Ω and 1200 Ω respectively. The average phase velocity of the signal in the circuit is 3×107 m/s. If the largest distance of a connection is 300 Km, determine the attenuation to be inserted in the circuit.
